```plaintext
Claim 26 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID or a salicylic acid NSAID, wherein the non-aqueous carrier is free from water; wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved.

Claim 33 (previously presented): (Previously Submitted) The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin, wherein lecithin contains phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 35 (previously presented): (Previously Submitted) The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is lecithin, which includes phosphatidylcholine.

Claim 51 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
```
